candidates.change_summary: Replace the require condition with one that always fails (preventing depositsCount from increasing), causing receive to revert and leaving depositsCount unchanged.
Remove the require condition so receive always increments depositsCount when called (if the call does not revert for other reasons).
Change the increment to a decrement so depositsCount decreases when receive is invoked.
Insert a conditional that only increments depositsCount when msg.value is greater than zero, leaving it unchanged for zero-value transfers.
Replace the safe increment with an unchecked increment to alter arithmetic behavior on overflow (though with pragma ^0.8.0 this changes overflow handling).
Replace call to withdraw with a direct transfer to owner (removes internal call and uses transfer from contract to owner), changing effects when withdraw is overridden or modified.
Call withdraw with zero value instead of full balance, so withdrawAll ends leaving funds in contract.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove require), so withdrawAll can be called by anyone and may transfer funds to that caller instead of owner.
Replace transfer with call that forwards gas and does not revert on failure, changing whether funds are sent and whether reversion occurs.
Remove the require check so withdraw can be called by any address, changing who can cause the contract to send funds.
Replace the low-level call with a call that forwards zero wei (value set to 0) causing sendMoney to no longer transfer the requested value.
Replace the low-level call with a transfer that will revert on failure, changing behavior when the target reverts or rejects funds.
Replace the low-level call with a call that includes the provided value but checks the returned success boolean and reverts on failure, changing observable outcomes when the call fails.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), which changes who can call sendMoney and thus observable state after sendMoney.
